description: Describe the used car you want in plain English, for example "diesel estate under 8000 no older than 8 years" or "2.0L Audi Q3 automatic" or "automatic with Apple CarPlay under 15000" (equipment such as CarPlay, Android Auto, sat nav, heated seats or a reversing camera is matched where the dealer lists it), and get matching live MotifyMe marketplace listings. If nothing matches every detail, the closest real cars are returned and the ignored details are listed.

request.description: Plain-English description of the car wanted

name: ai_car_search
title: Search cars by describing them
